Since 1974 the town of Düren in the Rhineland has held the Cherry Stone Spitting World Championship at its Annakirmes fair every year: competitors eat a cherry and spit the stone as far as they can along a marked track. The men's world record at Düren stands at 22.52 metres, set by Thomas Steinhauer in 2017; longer distances have been recorded elsewhere – the Guinness record of 28.51 metres was set in the United States in 2004 – but under different rules.

and wife carrying is its best-known export.
